name: arknights-training-room
description: 训练室（测试版）：明日方舟本地专精规划桌面应用
author: Arknights Training Room contributors

scripts.build:assets: npm run clean && tsc && node scripts/copy-static.mjs && node scripts/build-resource.mjs && node scripts/prepare-native.mjs && node scripts/generate-third-party-licenses.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:assets && tauri build --no-bundle && node scripts/sync-local-app.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build:assets && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib --test resources && cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --example domain-check && node --test dist/tests/*.test.js tests/*.test.mjs && node scripts/qa-domain.mjs
scripts.qa:packaged: tauri build --no-bundle --features qa && node scripts/qa-packaged-resource.mjs && tauri build --no-bundle && node scripts/sync-local-app.mjs
scripts.benchmark:performance: cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --release --example domain-check && node scripts/benchmark-performance.mjs
scripts.benchmark:desktop: tauri build --no-bundle --features qa && node scripts/benchmark-core-flow.mjs native && tauri build --no-bundle && node scripts/sync-local-app.mjs
scripts.dist: npm test && tauri build --bundles nsis && node scripts/sync-local-app.mjs && node scripts/package-native.mjs
